description: Na₃CaAl₃Si₃CO₁₅ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.53 Å. Ca is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one C and three equivalent O atoms. The Ca-C bond length is 2.22 Å. All Ca-O bond lengths are 2.43 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.85 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.70 Å. C is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Ca and three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.29 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Al and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Al and one Si atom.
